summary: The Custom Report Request module allows users to create and manage custom reports within the system, handling parameters like department, program, cohort, and specific report types tailored for different user roles such as students, staff, and site-related services. The module includes various views for handling inputs related to educational programs, user authorizations, site selections, and data fields. It integrates with user session settings, allowing tailored access and customization based on user roles.
purpose: To facilitate the creation and customization of reports by capturing specific parameters and data fields needed by different entities within the organization, allowing tailored reports for students, staff, and sites.

fields.name: ddReportType
fields.description: Dropdown for selecting report type based on user role (e.g., student, staff, site).

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.description: TextBox for entering the start date of the report period.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: TextBox for entering the end date of the report period.

fields.name: txtStudentDataFields
fields.description: TextBox for entering custom data fields required for student reports.

fields.name: txtPurpose
fields.description: TextBox for specifying the purpose of the report.

fields.name: txtAudience
fields.description: TextBox for identifying the audience for the report.

fields.name: txtStudentInformation
fields.description: TextBox for entering student information required for personalized reports.

fields.name: txtStudentAuthorization
fields.description: TextBox for entering student authorization details for the report.

fields.name: upldUploadFile
fields.description: File upload control for attaching files with the report.

actors.name: User
actors.description: General user interacting with the report request module.

actors.name: Staff
actors.description: Staff member involved in requesting or processing reports.

actors.name: System Administrator
actors.description: Administrator who manages system settings impacting reports.

workflows.name: Create Custom Report
steps: User selects the report type from the dropdown.
User fills in the required fields including start date, end date, and relevant data fields.
User attaches any necessary files using the upload control.
User submits the report request for processing.

workflows.name: Setup Header Information
steps: Retrieve and display user information (name, email, agency, department).
Setup JavaScript variables for handling client-side interactions.

business_rules: Report types are restricted by user role; only applicable types are selectable.
Start and end dates must be valid calendar dates, enforced through validation controls.

validations.name: RequiredFieldValidator
validations.description: Ensures that mandatory fields are filled before submission.

validations.name: RegularExpressionValidator
validations.description: Validates input format, especially for date fields.

conditions.description: Activation of different views based on the selected report type.

system_behavior: Displays error or warning panels based on the validation of user input or system status.

dependencies.name: UserSession
dependencies.description: Handles session-specific data and user roles.

exceptions.description: File upload errors if the file is not compliant with the allowed types.
